sentence: To change the focus, build trousers around a gray top and try cream below rather than retaining every color in its original position.
en_before: Cream is easy to try with warm-leaning gray. Dark-brown shoes or a tea-colored bag can provide an endpoint. Cream can also work with blue-gray, but inspect it directly because warm-cool contrast is stronger than with neutral white.
